title: chore: Sync the id when DefaultHttp2FrameStream's stream is updated.

timeline.message: chore: Sync the id when DefaultHttp2FrameStream's stream is updated.
timeline.author: He-Pin

timeline.body:
Motivation:

Keep the id in sync

Modification:

update the id when stream is updated.

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14801
hmm... There must be a bug then as we actually guard against this in the assert above.

reply.body: I don't get it... What I mean is the assert above basically should trigger. So either the assert is wrong or something else is fishy..

the `newStream` call creates a new `DefaultHttp2FrameStream` which `id` is `-1` and the assert will pass when you first call `setStreamAndProperty`, I think the code is right, just not handy when you do debug which shows `-1` in debugger.
